scope: Actual lower-image algebra left corners, six/four coefficient bases and equivalences, actual C-linear right multiplication by u/ell_n with whole-vector formulas and all-degree kernel-image equalities with explicit preimages
coefficient_ring_requirement: Corner and coordinate identities: commutative ring of characteristic two, arbitrary q. Kernel-image equalities: field of characteristic two with precisely the stated adjacent nonzero power factors; q itself need not be nonzero.
